slides.texte_overlay:
6 things you should
keep to yourself

1. Your next move
Announce it after it's done.
Plans shared too early
collect doubt.

2. Family arguments
They'll make up next week.
Others will remember forever.

3. A friend's secret
Even after the friendship ends.
Especially then.

4. Every complaint about work
Vent once to one person.
Not to everyone.

5. What you're learning
Just keep doing it daily.
People will notice the change.
